description: A TIMING probe, not a modelling run: phys_timing2_base_25pct plus the events-pipeline and replanning-pool knobs the 9.57 arm's forensics point at - eventsManager threads 4 -> 12 (the busiest events runnable burned ~119 s CPU against a 145 s mobsim wall; handlers are observers, so the knob is wall-time-only, the 9.56 verified class) and the replanning pool raised to 20 threads (the arm ran replanning at a median 59 s with 14 of 24 CPUs idle; RUN IDENTITY - the 9.58/9.59 family boundary is where such a change is free). oneThreadPerHandler was in this probe's first form and CRASHED MATSim (IllegalStateException: .initProcessing() has to be called before processing events - the experimental path 9.56 declined, now measured fatal; 9.59). NOTHING PRODUCED UNDER THIS OVERLAY IS A RESULT.

justification.RUN.controler.last_iteration: The declared sweep starts at 250 because that is the largest value MEASURED to be insufficient for convergence (DECISIONS.md 9.7, 9.43), so the range describes candidate MODELLING runs. This is a wall-clock measurement priced before the converged arm's relaunch. The value is deliberately far below the declared range so any output carrying it is obviously not a result.
